# Lab 9.5: Build an Org, Folder & Project Hierarchy

## What We Are Going to Do
Create folders for environments, place projects in them, and see how IAM roles granted on a folder are inherited.

## Steps

1. **Find your organization ID.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud organizations list</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create folders.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud resource-manager folders create --display-name="Production" --organization=ORG_ID
gcloud resource-manager folders create --display-name="Non-Production" --organization=ORG_ID
gcloud resource-manager folders list --organization=ORG_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create a project inside a folder.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects create pcse-dev-$RANDOM --folder=NONPROD_FOLDER_ID --name="pcse-dev"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Link it to your billing account in **Billing → Account management** if you will create resources in it.

4. **Grant a role on the folder.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud resource-manager folders add-iam-policy-binding NONPROD_FOLDER_ID \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/editor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **See inheritance.** Open the new project's **IAM** page. `gcp-developers` shows **Editor** with **Inheritance** pointing to the Non-Production folder. It cannot be removed at project level.

6. **Move a project.** In **IAM & Admin → Manage resources**, select a project, click **Migrate**, and choose a folder. Its inherited roles change immediately.

7. **Clean up.** Delete the test project and folders when you finish this section.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects delete PROJECT_ID_OF_DEV --quiet
gcloud resource-manager folders delete NONPROD_FOLDER_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Folder role | Inherited by every project inside |
| Inherited binding | Removed only where it was granted |
| Moving a project | Changes inherited roles and policies |
| Folder delete | Only when the folder is empty |
